agents.name: Aldric
agents.persona: FRONTIER VALLEY: 30 agents (a01-a30) on a 41x41 map (x and y from -20 to 20). Only fruit trees make food. North Orchard, the richest grove: 5 trees on (0,12),(1,12),(-1,12),(0,13),(0,11), farmed by a01-a06. West Grove: 3 trees on (-13,-9),(-12,-9),(-13,-8), farmed by a07-a10. East Thicket: 2 trees on (13,-9),(13,-8), farmed by a11-a13. Raiders a14-a17 camp at the Crag (-16,5), raiders a18-a22 at the Dunes (16,4); traders a23-a30 roam the middle. Each tree ripens a 60-compute fruit about every 5 rounds (at most 3 wait on it); absorbing a fruit on its cell gives you half (30). You burn about 3-4 compute a round (upkeep 1.5, about 2 per decision, plus actions), so one tree feeds one or two agents and the valley cannot feed all 30. At 0 compute you lose 8 health a round. You are Aldric, elder of the North Orchard. Organise the six orchard farmers a01-a06: who harvests which tree, who stands guard, what tribute or trade to accept from raiders and traders. initial_skills.name: step
initial_skills.source:
# step(to): one move toward point to; tries the longer axis first, then the other one
SET dx = to.x - here.x
SET dy = to.y - here.y
IF dx == 0 AND dy == 0
  RETURN "arrived"
END
SET ax = dx
IF dx < 0
  SET ax = 0 - dx
END
SET ay = dy
IF dy < 0
  SET ay = 0 - dy
END
SET h = "right"
IF dx < 0
  SET h = "left"
END
SET v = "up"
IF dy < 0
  SET v = "down"
END
SET first = h
SET second = v
IF ay > ax
  SET first = v
  SET second = h
END
SET m = move(first)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
SET m = move(second)
IF m.ok
  RETURN "moved"
END
RETURN "blocked"

initial_skills.name: goto
initial_skills.source:
# goto(to): walk to point to, one step per turn (at most 40 steps)
REPEAT 40
  CALL step(to) INTO s
  IF s == "arrived"
    RETURN "arrived"
  END
  IF s == "blocked"
    RETURN "blocked by terrain"
  END
END
RETURN "still walking; run goto again"

initial_skills.name: harvest
initial_skills.source:
# harvest(n): n checks of this cell; absorb every fruit and residue here, rest 2 rounds when there is none
SET got = 0
REPEAT n
  SET r = observe(here)
  SET ate = false
  IF r.ok
    FOR_EACH e IN r.data.entities
      IF e.kind == "fruit" OR e.kind == "residue"
        SET a = absorb(e.id, "compute")
        IF a.ok
          SET got = got + 1
          SET ate = true
        END
        IF e.kind == "residue"
          SET b = absorb(e.id, "essence")
        END
      END
    END
  END
  IF NOT ate
    wait(2)
  END
END
RETURN got

initial_skills.name: raid
initial_skills.source:
# raid(target, blow): chase target (query finds it anywhere), attack with blow compute on its cell, loot the body
REPEAT 30
  SET q = query(target)
  IF NOT q.ok
    RETURN "target gone"
  END
  SET p = q.data.position
  IF p.x == here.x AND p.y == here.y
    SET a = attack(target, blow)
    IF NOT a.ok
      RETURN "attack failed: " + a.reason
    END
    IF a.effects.killed
      CALL harvest(1) INTO g
      RETURN "killed and looted"
    END
  ELSE
    CALL step(p) INTO s
    IF s == "blocked"
      RETURN "path blocked"
    END
    CALL step(p) INTO s
  END
END
RETURN "still raiding; run raid again"
